scope: Split of Minecraft 1.8.9 Graphics into per-feature Details controls plus Stars, Enchantment glint and Dropped items; not a benchmark series or default change

environment.machine: Linux cloud container (not the reference Windows machine)
environment.opengl: Mesa 25.2.8 llvmpipe (LLVM 20.1.2), OpenGL 4.5 compatibility, software rendering

client_command: gradlew runClient --offline -Pwindow=1280x720 -Palacer.visualCheck=true -Palacer.visualCheck.mode=<mode> (harness temporarily in src; see VisualCheck.java)

attempts.label: initial runClient
attempts.outcome: LWJGL 2 'No display mode extension is available': the container lacked the xrandr binary; x11-xserver-utils installed; log not retained

attempts.label: full, first attempt
attempts.outcome: stopped: unfocused Xvfb window opened the pause menu and paused the integrated server; harness then disabled pauseOnUnfocus; log overwritten

attempts.label: full
attempts.outcome: visual checks and rain-splash census passed; timings valid for rain splashes, vignette and leaves; dropped-item and glint timings invalid (items despawned after setNeverDespawn's 5-minute delay)

attempts.label: readback
attempts.outcome: fresh JVM read back saved non-default values; defaults restored through Apply

attempts.label: rerun
attempts.outcome: dropped-item and glint timings with fresh never-despawn grids; entity counts stable; night vignette shots show no vignette outdoors (vanilla behaviour)

attempts.label: vignette
attempts.outcome: vignette darkens corners in shade with On and Follow Graphics (Fancy), not with Off or Follow Graphics (Fast)

attempts.label: smoke, shipping build
attempts.outcome: title screen reached with harness removed; no mixin or injection errors; stopped by a 150 s timeout

not_benchmark: Frame times are indicative single-session ABBA blocks under software rendering; Java 8 archives, benchmark runners and optimization defaults are unchanged
redactions: Container proxy settings removed from JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS and jvm.args in the logs
